title: DeathTime
description: Tic tac! Every player now has a timer. Let it hit zero, and you're done for!
body:
# ️ DeathTime

**DeathTime** is a Minecraft plugin that makes the survival experience way more harder than it could be. To make that true, it implements a game mechanic where everyone has a Death clock, once it reaches 0 player gets temporally banned to avoid that player need to constantly kill enemies!

## Features
 **Easy configuration** - The plugin itself works really well just with plug and drop, but there is some configuration you can perk to make the experience more unique
 **Database** - It works with a database so it could work in multiple servers connected to the same database
 **Placeholders support** - You can use %deathtime_time_left% as a per player placeholder to allow users see their remaining time
## 📥 Installation

1. **Download the plugin** from the [Releases](https://github.com/andrewyernau/DeathTime/releases) section or here.  
2. Place `DeathTime.jar` into your server’s `plugins/` folder.
3. Restart your server.  
4. (Optional) Configure settings in `config.yml`.

##  How It Works

###  For Admins
 Admins can set, freeze,unfreze, pardon, give time to all players for easy management
###  For Players
 Players can only check their time left and to not get banned, they need to kill entities such as players, mobs previously configured by admins

## 🛡️ Permissions

| Permission                  | Default  | Description |
|-----------------------------|----------|------------|
| `deathtime.bypass`       |  op  | Timer does not count on that player. |
| `deathtime.command.admin`  |  op    | Grants access to admin commands. |

## Supported Languages
- English (en)
- Spanish (es)

Want another language? Just edit the `language.yml` file or add a custom `.yml` translation!
